One app registration in Microsoft Entra lets each person connect their Outlook mail and calendar, read only. Sign in with Microsoft is a separate registration, below.

**Used by:** [OpenCRM](/docs/apps/crm) for Outlook mail (the `mail.read` set).

## Connect accounts

Each person connects their own Microsoft 365 account in the Gateway, once, and every app that asks uses it. Apps never see the tokens. [How connecting works](/docs/connect-oauth)

The redirect URI to register, with your Gateway's address (like `apps.example.com`):

```text
https://<your gateway>/connect/microsoft-365/callback
```

1. Sign in to [Microsoft Entra → App registrations](https://entra.microsoft.com/#view/Microsoft_AAD_RegisteredApps/ApplicationsListBlade) with an account that administers your tenant, and select **New registration**.
2. Name it (people see the name). For **Supported account types**, choose any Entra ID tenant plus personal Microsoft accounts.
3. Under **Redirect URI**, platform **Web**, paste the redirect URI above, and select **Register**. Copy the **Application (client) ID**.
4. Under **API permissions → Add a permission → Microsoft Graph → Delegated**, add `User.Read`, `Mail.Read` and `offline_access` (and `Calendars.Read` if an app asks for `calendar.read`).
5. Under **Certificates & secrets → New client secret**, add one (24 months at most) and copy its **Value** right away. Note the expiry date.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the client ID and secret:

```bash
everyapp provider add microsoft-365
```

Or add it in **Manage workspace → Providers**.

### Use it in an app

```ts
capabilities: {
  "microsoft-365": { access: "read", scopes: ["mail.read"], why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

Apps ask for these scope sets:

| Set | Allows | Provider scopes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `identity` | Microsoft account (who you are) | `User.Read` |
| `mail.read` | Outlook mail (read-only) | `Mail.Read` |
| `calendar.read` | Outlook calendar (read-only) | `Calendars.Read` |

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show microsoft-365` shows the client as set. Then open the account menu → **Connected accounts** → **Connect Microsoft 365**.

## Sign in with Microsoft

Adds **Continue with Microsoft** to your Gateway's sign-in page, for people you've invited. [Sign-in](/docs/sign-in)

1. Open [entra.microsoft.com](https://entra.microsoft.com/#view/Microsoft_AAD_RegisteredApps/ApplicationsListBlade) and create an App registration.
2. Add the redirect URL `https://<your gateway>/api/auth/callback/microsoft`.
3. Copy:
   - `MICROSOFT_SIGNIN_CLIENT_ID`: The app registration's Application (client) ID.
   - `MICROSOFT_SIGNIN_CLIENT_SECRET`: A client secret from Certificates & secrets (it expires; 24 months at most)

- Without MICROSOFT\_SIGNIN\_TENANT, add the optional claims `email` and `xms_edov` under Token configuration, or every sign-in is refused as unverified: any tenant's admin can put any address on their users.

Optional: `MICROSOFT_SIGNIN_TENANT`, The Directory (tenant) ID to pin sign-in to your own directory; unset means any Microsoft account (common), which then needs the xms\_edov claim.

Turn it on. It asks for each value:

```bash
everyapp signin add microsoft
```

**Check it worked:** `everyapp signin show microsoft` shows each setting as set. Then sign out and select the button.
